analysis.analysis: The OCTANG-003 inversion graduated to narrative: AI Mode composes a biography for Isabel Schöps-Thiel — including an asserted birth name — and frames a numbered 'Conflict Over Authorship and Affiliation' over the Constitution of the Semantic Economy, while resolving primary authorship to Lee Sharks as 'the digital theorist/collective.' The entanglement is narrated agentlessly ('became intertwined'), certifying the inversion's result while erasing its mechanism. Captured same-day as EA-MRE-01 (deposit #1428) and the sovereign blog restoration (#1365); relation held open in the case file. Evidence: data/captures/2026-07-31-schops-authorship-conflict/.
